{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent preset for making large engineering tasks deliberate, integrated, and verifiable from the first turn.","id":"gh:1336621274","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"hard-flash","slug":"Soulize/hard-flash","topics":["deepdeepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","prompt-engineering"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent preset for making large engineering tasks deliberate, integrated, and"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" verifiable from the first turn."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# hard-flash
> hard-flash"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"hard-flash is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent preset for making large engineering tasks deliberate, i"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ntegrated, and verifiable from the first turn.
hard-flash 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 agent preset，"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"目标是在第一轮就让大型工程任务进入深思考、强集成、可验证的工作状态。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**The preset is designed for users who prefer correctness over speed, full capability over toy demon"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"strations, and real-path verification over code that merely looks plausible**.
**这个 preset 适合优先追求正确率"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"、完整能力和真实用户路径验证，而不是追求速度或只交付看起来可行的示例的用户**。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The package is intentionally small: the preset composition declares the available dsh tools, while r"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"outer-bootstrap.mjs controls the first-turn routing and the shared engineering discipline.
本包有意保持精简："},{"id":"p5s3","text":"preset composition 负责声明 dsh 工具，router-bootstrap.mjs 负责首轮工具路由和统一的工程执行纪律。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Background and motivation"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 背景与动机"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"hard-flash started from a practical observation: for DeepSeek V4 Flash, visible chain-of-thought sty"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"le is not a reliable proxy for the quality of the final engineering result.
hard-flash 源于一个工程观察：对于 D"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eepSeek V4 Flash，可见的思维链风格并不是最终工程交付质量的可靠代理指标。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The two original GitHub discussions that motivated this direction are dsh-router-standard issue #18 "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"and v4-flash-godmode-opencode-go issue #2.
推动这个方向的两个原始 GitHub 讨论是 dsh-router-standard issue #18 和 v4"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"-flash-godmode-opencode-go issue #2。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Issue #18 reports a descriptive study of twelve sessions on the same broad task, with one configurat"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ion repeated as UP2; it explicitly warns that the sample is small and should not be read as causal p"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"roof.
Issue #18 记录了同一宽泛任务上的十二个会话，其中一个配置以 UP2 形式重复运行；它明确说明样本很小，不能被解读为因果证明。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Its strongest practical signal is that trajectory is not the same thing as quality: the UP and UP2 r"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"uns used the same preset shape and showed nearly the same language fingerprint, yet their reported s"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"cores were 85.7 and 42.9.
其中最有工程意义的信号是：思维链不等于质量；UP 和 UP2 使用相同的 preset 形态并表现出几乎相同的语言指纹，但报告分数分别为 85.7 "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ere 85.7 and 42.9.
其中最有工程意义的信号是：思维链不等于质量；UP 和 UP2 使用相同的 preset 形态并表现出几乎相同的语言指纹，但报告分数分别为 85.7 和 42.9。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The same discussion also reports that prompt injection can change phrases such as `we`, `let me`, an"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"d `I` without reliably changing the quality of the produced software.
同一讨论还记录了提示词注入可以改变 `we`、`let me"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"`、`I` 等表达方式，但并不能可靠地改变生成软件的质量。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In that evidence,**prompting behaves more like a behavior switch than a quality switch, while implem"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"entation details, verification depth, and accidental failures remain decisive**.
在这些证据中，**提示词更像是行为开关"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"而不是质量开关，而实现细节、验证深度和偶发失败仍然是决定性因素**。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### The deliberate trade-off"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 有意进行的资源交换"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"hard-flash responds by trading time and token budget for a lower probability of hallucinated or unve"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rified delivery.
hard-flash 的应对方式是用更多时间和 token 预算，换取更低的幻觉交付和未经验证交付概率。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"In the reported comparison, the same hard-flash prompt used approximately **1.5x wall-clock time, 5x"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" input tokens, and 3x output tokens** compared with the lighter setup.
在这次对比记录中，同一段 hard-flash 提示词相较"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"于dsh-router-standard 0.2.0 提示词配置大约使用了 **1.5 倍工作时间、5 倍输入 token 和 3 倍输出 token**。"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Those ratios are observations from this comparison, not a universal benchmark or a promise for every"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" provider and task.
这些比例是本次对比中的观察值，不是适用于所有 provider 和任务的通用基准，也不是固定承诺。"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The design goal is simple: **spend more budget on inspection, architecture, integration, checkpoints"},{"id":"p20s2","text":", and real-path verification when correctness matters more than latency**.
设计目标很直接：**当正确率比延迟更重要时，把更多"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"预算投入到检查、架构、集成、checkpoint 和真实路径验证上**。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Controlled comparison: a browser Chinese-chess task"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 受控对比：中国象棋网页任务"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**No vision-capable model** was introduced in this comparison; the intended variable was the **syste"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"m prompt** rather than a model upgrade.
这次对比没有引入**视觉模型**；有意控制的变量是**系统提示词**，而不是更换模型。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**The task was to build a browser-based Chinese chess game with AI vs AI and player vs AI modes, whi"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"le researching or fetching suitable materials, assets, and textures online when necessary.**
[该节后续省略"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"e researching or fetching suitable materials, assets, and textures online when necessary.**
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What hard-flash changes"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 运行要求"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"You need a dsh installation that supports agent presets, Cordis composition files, the `system-promp"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t/assemble` hook, and the tool names referenced by agent.cordis.yml.
你需要安装支持 agent preset、Cordis com"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"position 文件、`system-prompt/assemble` hook 以及 agent.cordis.yml 中工具名称的 dsh 版本。"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The hard-flash package does not install dsh, model providers, credentials, or external plugins for y"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ou.
hard-flash 不会代替你安装 dsh、模型 provider、凭据或外部插件。"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The router is JavaScript and is loaded by dsh; the deployment scripts only use shell or PowerShell b"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"uilt-ins plus standard file-copy commands.
路由器是由 dsh 加载的 JavaScript；部署脚本只使用 shell 或 PowerShell 内置能力以"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"lus standard file-copy commands.
路由器是由 dsh 加载的 JavaScript；部署脚本只使用 shell 或 PowerShell 内置能力以及标准文件复制命令。"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The preset expects the dsh tool catalog to provide at least one platform shell, otherwise the router"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" reports `router-bootstrap: no platform shell in catalog`.
这个 preset 至少要求 dsh 工具目录提供一个平台 shell，否则路由器"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"会报告 `router-bootstrap: no platform shell in catalog`。"}],"truncated":true}
